description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternalResources' that extends another class and implements a resource filtering mechanism within the HTMLPurifier library, specifically to disable external resource loading based on context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_DisableExternalResources
classes.description: PHP class that disables external resource loading in the HTMLPurifier library by overriding the filter method to check context settings.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a URI based on the context; disables external resources if 'EmbeddedURI' is false.
